LightningComponentBundle.description: Upload CSV via drag-and-drop, convert to SObjects with a DataWeave script, and return rows to Flow without DML.

propertyType.name: T
propertyType.label: Target object type
propertyType.description: SObject type for converted records returned to the flow

property.name: scriptApiName
property.label: DataWeave Script API Name
property.description: API name of the deployed .dwl script (no path or extension)

property.name: targetObjectApiName
property.label: Target Object API Name
property.description: API name of the SObject type the script produces (must match the selected target object type)

property.name: label
property.label: Label
property.description: Label shown above the drop zone

property.name: maxFileSizeBytes
property.label: Max File Size (bytes)
property.description: Maximum CSV file size accepted on the client before calling Apex

property.name: successMessageTemplate
property.label: Success Message Template
property.description: Message shown after a successful upload and transform. Use $0 for the record count.
property.default: $0 record(s) loaded. Data is ready for the flow (not saved to Salesforce).

property.name: failureMessageTemplate
property.label: Failure Message Template
property.description: Message shown when upload or transform fails. Use $0 for the error detail.

property.name: convertedRecords
property.label: Converted Records
property.description: SObject rows produced by the DataWeave script (not persisted)

property.name: errorMessage
property.label: Error Message
property.description: Set when validation or conversion fails
